# FoliageMesh

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("FoliageMesh")`

One mesh that a `FoliageLayer` grows. It sets the mesh's share of the layer, its size, how it sits on the ground and how the wind moves it.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AlignToNormal` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How much an instance leans with the slope of the ground, from 0 (upright) to 1 (perpendicular to the ground). |
| `CastShadow` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the mesh casts a shadow. Foliage casts shadows only near the camera, within `[render] foliage_shadow_distance`. |
| `Material` | `Material?` | — | read/write | The material the mesh is drawn with, or empty to use the mesh's own. The material's maps and values are used. Its surface shader is not run on foliage yet: the built-in sway bends the mesh from its base. |
| `Mesh` | `Content` | `""` | read/write | The mesh to grow. Any mesh asset in the project can be used. |
| `RandomRotation` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether each instance is rotated by a random angle about its up axis, so that the field does not look like rows of identical copies. |
| `ScaleMax` | `number` | `1.2` | read/write | The largest scale of an instance, as a multiple of the mesh's size. |
| `ScaleMin` | `number` | `0.8` | read/write | The smallest scale of an instance, as a multiple of the mesh's size. |
| `Sink` | `number` | `0.05` | read/write | How far below the ground the base of an instance is placed, in meters, so that a stem on a slope does not float at one edge. |
| `Stiffness` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How strongly the mesh resists the wind. A reed is about 0.5 and a bush about 3. |
| `Weight` | `number` | `1` | read/write | The mesh's share of the layer's instances, relative to the layer's other meshes. Two meshes with weights 1 and 3 grow in a ratio of one to three. |
| `WindResponse` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How much the wind moves the mesh, from 0 (still) to 1 (full sway). |
